verdict.rationale: Docs show most Issuing operations are API-first (create/manage cards, transaction rules, relayed authorization, disputes, webhooks), but several capabilities are explicitly Customer Area-only: configuring relayed authorization webhooks (docs-6), uploading dispute evidence as a zip (docs-8, pilot), and viewing card payments (docs-13/20). This means not everything doable in the UI is exposed via API. missing for 10: API-equivalent for relayed-auth webhook configuration, API-based dispute file upload, API-based payment viewing/reporting parity, and any independent/third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs.
